name: inspira-progressive-blur
blurb: Progressive blur effect fading from edges using backdrop-filter layers.
description: Wrapper with layered backdrop-filter blur that gradually increases from a specified direction. Uses gradient masks and motion/react for smooth animations.
use_when: Hero images, overlays, or content areas needing edge fading without sharp cutoffs.
a11y: Blur layers are decorative overlays; semantic content provided via children.
